abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack.

Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, and MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE wrote combat.total_defense, which _resolve_damage recomputes from sum(card.defense) immediately before damage -- so the value was discarded even when something did set it. WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_DEFENSE with MODIFY_DEFENSE moves the DEFENDING CARD's own {d}, which is what survives into the total. IN_COMBAT combat_type DEFEND is not how the engine knows a card is defending; IS_DEFENDING_CARD names the defender being evaluated.

_comment:
Implementation copied verbatim from yinti_yanti_yellow, whose printed functional text is identical to this card's once each card's own name is substituted out. Everything that differs between them -- cost, pitch, power, colour -- comes from the card DB, not from this file, so the DSL is the same card twice.

THE COPY IS PINNED, not trusted: tests/test_copied_card_implementations.py asserts that these abilities still match yinti_yanti_yellow's and that the two printed texts still agree, so a later edit to one cannot silently leave the other behind. That is the insult_to_injury failure -- three printings of one sentence with three different implementations, the blue one missing a gate the others had.
